title: nfl.ledger.record.v1 - one line of data/ledger.ndjson
description: Append-only. Core = hash, artifact, timestamp. Record hash = SHA-256 of the compact core {"hash":..,"artifact":..,"timestamp":..} (nfl.ledger.core.canon.v1, keys in that order, RFC 8259 minimal escaping). seq is the 0-based line index; prev is the link hash of the previous line or GENESIS for line 0, where link = record hash for a line without prev, else SHA-256("nfl.ledger.selfchain.v1\n" + prev + "\n" + record hash) (nfl.ledger.selfchain.v1). data/ledger.selfchain.json pins chain_start_seq, the first chained line. Lines written before self-chaining (2026-10) have no seq/prev and form an unchained prefix. Optional string fields: schema (nfl.ledger.commit.v2 from the API), source_repo, source_repo_path, branch, commit_hash, remote, event_type. Artifact labels in use: free text (operator commits), 'constellation.integration.receipt.v1:<consumer>><provider>' (integration receipts), 'nfl.ingest.v1:<producer>:<packet_id>' (ingested envelopes), 'packet:<source>:<inbox>' (verified packets without an envelope).
